## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the change (a detection rule: a case it finds and a similar one it leaves alone)
- [ ] `pnpm turbo run build test type-check` passes
- [ ] A changeset (`pnpm changeset`) for every package users will see change
- [ ] README updated if behaviour or options changed
- [ ] No real secrets or personal data in tests, fixtures or screenshots
